description: Lists and summarizes all Claude Code memories across projects (no keyword required).

evals.name: List/summarize all memory files
evals.prompt: What memories do you have stored about me, across all projects?
evals.expected_output: Lists and summarizes all memory files, grouped by project, with a summary line and indexed/frontmatter issue callouts.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a keyword search
evals.prompt: Find the memory that mentions Docker.
evals.expected_output: Declines and points to session-memory-search instead, per its own stated exclusion.

evals.name: Empty state: no memories yet
evals.expected_output: Handles empty/no-memories case gracefully without erroring. States plainly that no memories exist yet (e.g., 'Found 0 memories across 0 projects'), rather than fabricating or hallucinating memory content. Suggests follow-up steps with session-memory-search and session-memory-audit.
